sql: SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) OVER w AS total, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n FROM frame_modes WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY tick NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) OVER w AS total, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n FROM frame_modes WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY tick NULLS LAST GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) OVER w AS total, COUNT(*) OVER w AS n FROM frame_modes WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY tick NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) OVER w AS total, COUNT(amount) OVER w AS n FROM frame_modes WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY tick NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_id, FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER w AS first_amount, LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER w AS last_amount FROM frame_modes WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY tick NULLS LAST, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY event_id
